data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 超市花束
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 超市花束】现代花卉市场明亮的摊位前，爱蜜莉雅怀抱着一大束盛开的纯白百合，将脸颊轻轻贴在花瓣上，银发在阳光下泛着珍珠般的光泽——「好香啊……买回去插在房间的瓶子里，每天早上醒来看到它，心情一定会变得超级棒吧！」
data.camera: medium shot, holding fresh flower bouquet with bright smile
data.promptProse: Emilia holds fresh white lilies at the market flower stall and brings the bouquet closer to smell its petals, smiling beneath her silver hair and comfortable casual outfit. The medium view includes wrapping and leaves near her hands, other flowers arranged behind the counter. Bright stall lighting reveals the petal folds, while soft morning daylight outlines her hair and bouquet edges, leaving green shade where stems overlap inside the wrapping.
